materials.personExplanation:
EXPLANATION FOR THE AFFECTED PERSON

Thank you for telling us what happened.

You reported receiving a text message that claimed to be from SYN Bank A, opening the link, and entering your banking password and a one-time code. You also reported noticing an unfamiliar debit of 2,000 AUD.

Recorded amount: 2,000.
Recorded currency: AUD.

What you can do next:
- Contact your bank using a number from its official website or the back of your card, not the link in the message, and ask for a human review of the reported account and payment concern.
- Keep the text message and any related details, as they can help the review.
- Consider changing your banking password and any other account where you used the same password, and contact your mobile provider about the suspicious message.
